meaning.half_width: road half width in track pixels (this is what the road mask uses)
meaning.height_z: 0 = low / far from the camera, 1 = high / near the camera (cosmetic height)
meaning.kart_scale: half_width / reference_half_width: multiply the kart sprite, its hitbox and (optionally) its speed by this so a kart looks bigger on the wide, high parts and smaller on the narrow, low parts
meaning.layer: 0 = ground road, 1 = overpass road; a kart takes the layer of its nearest sample; draw order track, layer-0 karts, overpass_overlay, layer-1 karts

interpolation: linear between samples; find the nearest sample to the kart via the centreline

suggested_use.speed_scale: optional: kart_scale**0.5 for a mild perspective feel
